rawFindings.title: Invalid access of possibly non-Identifier node in VariableDeclarator
rawFindings.explanation: The changed code removes a prior check for node.id.type === 'Identifier' on a VariableDeclarator node, but then compares node.id.name without ensuring node.id is an Identifier node. If node.id is not an Identifier (e.g., a pattern node from destructuring), accessing node.id.name will throw an error.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add a check to ensure node.id is an Identifier node before accessing node.id.name to avoid runtime exceptions.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Parsing a variable declarator with a non-Identifier id (e.g., const {a} = function foo() {}) causes an exception when the rule accesses node.id.name without verifying node.id.type. The rule crashes instead of gracefully skipping.
